name: Schwabach (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Schwabach (a tower on an arch between two small shields on red).
history: Municipal flag of Schwabach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schwabach arms — tower between shields on red
